high_level_description: This image captures a serene urban scene at dusk or early evening. The sky is a dramatic canvas of colors, transitioning from deep purples and blues at the top to warm oranges and yellows near the horizon. The clouds are scattered, with some appearing as wispy streaks, while others are denser and darker, adding depth to the sky. In the foreground, there are several silhouettes of streetlights and traffic signals. One traffic light on the left is illuminated red, indicating that vehicles should stop.
